column1: # Approving U2 means approving this table: it is where the severity, tier, scope
# and boot-gate calls for all 39 existing checks are visible in one place.
# U23/U24/U25 implement rows against it rather than re-deciding per section.
# severity  invariant = config declares X and X is true (blocks)
#           liveness  = a service responds right now (warns, never gates boot)
# boot_gate yes only where continuing to boot is worse than failing to boot
